summary: Finite-shot Hubbard energy, total double occupancy and kinetic energy use actual grouped Born counts, confidence intervals and exact prepared-state/ground-state references. Added fixed unequal-shot measurement and coefficient-range energy allocation with matched preparation budgets against equal grouped and independent-Pauli baselines. At U/t=8 and 20,480 preparations the energy CI half-width narrows 34.9% to 0.11388 t, while kinetic uncertainty grows 54.9%; worse seeded scan RMSE and the uninformative two-shot U=0 density result are retained. Studio charts and CSV expose all three strategies, uncertainty and actual setting counts. Legacy scalar-shot and VQE APIs remain compatible.
